title: Claude Can Now Log Into Sites for You — Without Seeing Your Password
hook: 1Password's new integration lets Claude use your saved logins to book travel or manage accounts on its own — but the password itself is designed to never reach the AI at all.
key_points: 1Password for Claude lets the AI use your saved logins and one-time codes to complete tasks like bookings.
1Password injects the credential directly into the page; Claude never sees the password or code itself.
Access is scoped to the current task and ends when the task is done; a biometric approval is required first.
The browser extension visibly locks down while an AI agent is acting, so you can see it's in control.
Requires 1Password's desktop app/extension plus a paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise).
content_html: AI agents that can actually act on your behalf — booking a flight, managing an account — need to log in somewhere first, which usually means handing over a password. 1Password's new integration with Claude is built to avoid exactly that. The Verge reports "1Password for Claude" lets Anthropic's chatbot use your stored credentials to complete multi-step tasks, without the underlying password or one-time code ever reaching Claude itself.
extra_html: The mechanism is the interesting part: after you give a biometric approval, 1Password injects the actual credential straight into the webpage — Claude triggers the login but never sees the vault item, the password, or the one-time code, and none of it touches Claude's memory or Anthropic's systems. Access is scoped to whatever task is underway and shuts off once it's finished, rather than staying open-ended. While an agent is acting, the 1Password browser extension visibly locks itself down, so you get a clear signal about when the AI — rather than you — is in the driver's seat. The feature requires the 1Password desktop app and extension plus a paid Claude plan. It's a useful template for a broader question every AI-agent feature will have to answer: not just "can the AI do this for me," but "what exactly does the AI get to see while it does it."

related.title: AI Agents: AI That Does Things
related.hook: A chatbot answers; an agent acts. The new frontier is AI that can browse, click, book, and complete multi-step tasks for you — powerful, and exactly why you keep it on a leash.

related.title: Your Data & Privacy
related.hook: When you type into a free AI tool, you might be the product. What you share can be stored, reviewed by humans, and used to train future models — so share like it's not private.

flashcards.prompt: How does 1Password keep your password safe from Claude itself?

choices.text: It injects the credential straight into the webpage, so Claude never sees the password or code
It emails you the password every time Claude uses it
It doesn't — Claude reads the password directly from your vault

flashcards.explanation_html: The password or one-time code goes straight from 1Password into the page. Claude only knows to trigger the login, never the secret itself.

flashcards.prompt: What has to happen before Claude can use a saved credential?
flashcards.back_html: You give a biometric approval, and access is scoped just to the current task — it ends automatically once that task is complete.

flashcards.prompt: How can you tell when an AI agent is actively using your 1Password vault?
flashcards.back_html: The 1Password browser extension visibly locks itself down while an agent is working, so you can see when it's in control versus you.
